events.title: Welcome to Alaska, White Pass
events.thought: Welcome to Alaska — for real this time. The gateway to the Klondike.
events.photoCaption: Welcome to Alaska and the Gateway to the Klondike — the border sign at White Pass in alpine glory.

events.title: Grizzly on Fish Creek
events.thought: A grizzly on Fish Creek coming straight at the lens — that's a good use of a telephoto.
events.photoCaption: A soaking wet grizzly bear strides along the rocks of Fish Creek near Hyder, heading straight for the camera.
